en.title: The Traveler Who Carries Goodbyes and the Map of Sunbeams
en.premise: My job is to journey through the world, fulfilling the "small wishes" left behind by those who have passed. These are not grand legacies, but quiet final requests—like, "I want someone to taste the apple pie from that town." Along the way, meeting former knights who use broken swords as walking sticks and artisans who weave the wind, I record the gentle, fleeting moments scattered across the world in my diary.

zh.title: 传递告别的旅人与暖阳之图
zh.premise: 我的工作是踏上旅途，去实现逝者留下的“微小心愿”。那并非什么宏大的遗产，而是如“希望有人能尝尝那个小镇的苹果派”这样，静谧遗愿的代行。在与拄着断剑为拐杖生活的退役骑士、以及编织清风的匠人们相遇的过程中，我将散落在世界各地的美好时光，一笔一画地记录在日记里。
